== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of '''•Galen's Fighter''' (Virtual Block 4, card 58), the original printing of [[Galen's Fighter]] (later retitled [[Rogue Shadow]]). It prints the original text: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. If Black Leader piloting, adds one battle destiny. If it just took off, may use its hyperspeed and land. Immune to attrition < 7 if Galen on table, even while landed.”

* '''Source:''' https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Dark/large/galensfighter.gif (the PC website card list links it as “Galen's Fighter”, captures 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013).
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
